reviews.review:
Honestly, it's fun so long as you play exactly as long as it holds your attention. The gunplay feels tight, many of the powers are fun and enjoyably overpowered, and the devs seem committed to rebalancing weaker Descendants. But it's not Destiny 2 or Warframe, and the players expecting it to be are setting themselves up to be disappointed.

I go through 2-3 weeks of play once or twice a year with my partner, after the devs have added enough new content and Descendants to give us something to do, and then we bench this again once it gets stale. Not everything has to give you hundreds (or thousands!) of hours to be worth *some* of your time.

Beyond that, the story is laughably bad and borderline incoherent, so turning character voices to low or zero volume and just blasting with friends or listening to a podcast while you play is advised.

Edited to add: The devs seem to take community feedback seriously and are constantly adding new QOL to this game, which I appreciate. There are (of course) some design decisions that not everyone likes, myself included, but they're a step above many live service devs on this one.
The micro transactions are pretty pricey but its a solid game otherwise
